stance_basis: requested formation of Joint Executive Committee to unite community support for rapid transit
summary: The Erie County Executive, along with the Mayor of the City of Buffalo, requested the formation of the Joint Executive Committee for Rapid Transit in May 1975, an action that demonstrates support for the mass transit project. The committee was designed to unite community groups in demonstrating support for rapid transit. No complaints or objections are attributed to the Erie County Executive in this window.

summary_quote: In May 1975, at the request of the Erie County Executive and the Mayor of the City of Buffalo, the Joint Executive Committee for Rapid Transit was formed.
